title: Indorser not guarantor for other parties.
bodyText: The indorsement of a tangible document of title issued by a bailee does not make the indorser liable for any default by the bailee or previous indorsers.
bodyHtml: §490:7-505  Indorser not guarantor for other parties.  The indorsement of a tangible document of title issued by a bailee does not make the indorser liable for any default by the bailee or previous indorsers. [L 2004, c 163, pt of §1]
